notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.notes:
- Life cards no longer show up when the player's life is at max, enabling you to improve your unit more efficiently by trying not to receive damage.
- Modified the flying distance of Space Grenade/Makibishi.

notes.title: v1.222
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that Caster appears at the start of Wave 22 and immediately dies.

notes.title: version 1.12
notes.notes:
- Decreased the growth rate of Aliens a little (now you can kill them slightly faster).
- Assigned W and Arrow Up key for throwing grenades. So now you can throw grenades with either G, W, or Arrow Up.
